# Archer Christian Academy

> Archer Christian Academy is a Christ-centered, classical Christian school opening in Fall 2027 in the Englewood neighborhood on the South Side of Chicago, Illinois. Its first day of school is August 23, 2027. It launches with kindergarten through 2nd grade (K–2), adds one grade each year through 12th grade, and caps classes at 14 students. It is a ministry of Urban Youth Outreach (also known as Englewood Family Outreach), a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has served Englewood families since 1986.

## Key facts

- Name: Archer Christian Academy (also "Archer" or "ACA")
- Type: Private, Christ-centered, classical Christian school (nonprofit); the first classical Christian school in Englewood and one of only a handful on Chicago's South Side
- Location: 672 West Marquette Road, Chicago, IL 60621 (Englewood, South Side of Chicago); a neighborhood school families can walk to
- Opening: Fall 2027 (first day of school August 23, 2027) with grades K–2; one grade added per year toward a full K–12 school
- Class size: 14 students per class (42 students in year one)
- Mission: to form students who think clearly, love rightly, and serve faithfully — raising a generation of wise, courageous leaders for the renewal of Englewood and the glory of God
- Educational model: The classical Trivium — Grammar School (K–5), Logic School (6–8), Rhetoric School (9–12) — plus Applied Arts (archery and woodworking)
- Grammar-stage subjects: phonics-based reading, classic children's literature, chronological history, mastery-focused mathematics, observational science, Latin, Scripture, music, and art
- Model and partners: modeled on Hope Academy (Minneapolis); coached through its launch by the Spreading Hope Network; curriculum and teacher-training partnership with Clapham School (Wheaton, Illinois)
- Tuition: Not a posted price. The true cost of an Archer education is about $12,000 per student per year. Every family contributes monthly; the amount is set individually and confidentially based on the family's resources (typically about 10% of the true cost), with the remaining cost covered by ministry partners. No mission-aligned family is turned away for financial reasons.
- Admissions: Open to families who desire a Christ-centered classical education; a church background or profession of faith is not required to apply. Four steps: conversation & tour, application & family story, partnership interview, enrollment decision.
- Parent organization: Urban Youth Outreach (Englewood Family Outreach), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 36-3382527; gifts are tax-deductible
- Launch funding: about $400,000 is estimated to carry the school through its launch (outreach to families, curriculum, furniture, hiring teachers)
- Mantra: "Launched true, for God and community." Motto: "sagitta vera" (true arrow)
- Founder & Head of School: Daniel M. Bair (also Executive Director of Urban Youth Outreach / Englewood Family Outreach)
- Director of Operations: Michelle Kelley
- Contact: daniel@archerchristian.org · 312-539-0644 · https://archerchristian.org/contact/
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/ArcherEnglewood/ · https://www.instagram.com/archerchristianacademy/ · https://www.linkedin.com/company/archerchristian

## Main pages

- [Home](https://archerchristian.org/): Overview of the school, launch plan, three ways in (families, teachers, partners), and a FAQ answering common questions about the school, classical Christian education, cost, admissions, and giving
- [About](https://archerchristian.org/about/): Purpose, vision, mission, values, and the Archer-and-Arrow guiding metaphor
- [A Letter from the Director](https://archerchristian.org/about/letter/): Why Archer exists, from Founder and Head of School Daniel M. Bair
- [Why Englewood](https://archerchristian.org/why-englewood/): The need in numbers — Chicago Public Schools grades 3–8 reading and math proficiency under the former standard (2024 Report Card: 30.5% ELA, 18.3% math) and the current standard adopted in August 2025 (2025 Report Card: 40.6% ELA, 26.2% math), the absence of classical Christian schools in Englewood and on the South Side, and Englewood household income, employment, and education data (ACS 2020–2024)
- [Our Nine Words](https://archerchristian.org/our-words/): The nine key words that define the school's culture
- [Academics](https://archerchristian.org/academics/): Educational philosophy, the Trivium stage by stage, applied arts, and the launch plan
- [Admissions](https://archerchristian.org/admissions/): The four-step admissions partnership and how family tuition works
- [Apply](https://archerchristian.org/apply/): Start an application for K–2, Fall 2027
- [Contact](https://archerchristian.org/contact/): Schedule a visit or ask a question

## For partners and teachers

- [Support the Vision](https://archerchristian.org/support/): How churches, individuals, and organizations can partner with the school; partnership levels — Student Sponsor $10,800 ($900/month) funds one student for a year, Semester Partner $5,400 ($450/month), Fletching Partner $3,600 ($300/month; three Fletching Partners fund one student), Archer Partner $25,000 (foundational launch gift), Advocate $1,200 ($100/month), Supporter $600 ($50/month)
- [Partner with Archer (Give)](https://archerchristian.org/partner/): Make a monthly or one-time tax-deductible gift online through a secure Little Green Light form (a Monthly / One-Time toggle selects the form), or give by donor-advised fund (incl. National Christian Foundation), check, IRA qualified charitable distribution, stock, multi-year pledge, or employer match. Gifts are made to Urban Youth Outreach (EIN 36-3382527), designated "Archer Christian Academy"; mailing address 1507 E 53rd St, Box 691, Chicago, IL 60615. The page also answers common donor questions.
- [Update Your Monthly Gift](https://archerchristian.org/partner/update/): Recurring (monthly) donors can request a change to the payment method, amount, or charge date of a recurring gift, or cancel it, through a secure Little Green Light form
- [Teach at Archer](https://archerchristian.org/careers/): Founding teacher positions for Fall 2027
- [Vision Breakfast](https://archerchristian.org/breakfast/): Informational event for prospective partners
